question: description
text_en: An article on the first channel with Yaakov Elon (which means it's quite old). Two hospitals in Jerusalem interpret the policy of "not putting in chametz on Pesach" differently. While the Hadassah hospital prohibits bringing in any type of food, the Shaarei Zedek hospital searches people's files and removes food that may be chametz. Rabbi Setu says that hospitals are like military bases - as the introduction of chametz is prohibited in the IDF during Passover, so that they do not come to fear of a prohibition (use of utensils, for example) it should be prohibited. The second rabbi (I don't remember his name, but is it related to a free Israel? Something like that) claims that this is an act that completely contradicts the fact of the Jewish and democratic state, and violates the rights of the people.
